subject.title: fix(ios): attach EKAlarm to reminders.add so due-time notifications fire

question: Should `reminders.add` treat every supplied `dueISO` as an instruction to schedule a user-visible EventKit alarm, including for existing callers?
rationale: EventKit distinguishes deadlines from alarms, while the current OpenClaw command exposes only `dueISO`; choosing notification-by-default changes established caller behavior and cannot be inferred safely from the one-line implementation.

options.title: Make due time notify
options.body: Confirm that `dueISO` includes notification semantics, keep the narrow alarm call, and require real-device proof before merge.

options.title: Add explicit alert control
options.body: Preserve deadline-only behavior by adding a separately reviewed command parameter for alarm scheduling and defining its compatibility default.

options.title: Keep deadline semantics
options.body: Decline the behavioral change and document that `dueISO` sets a deadline without scheduling an alert.

recommendation.title: Make due time notify
recommendation.body: Confirm that `dueISO` includes notification semantics, keep the narrow alarm call, and require real-device proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is a likely owner of the iOS app's original command semantics and can resolve whether notification behavior is intended product contract.
